latest_release.body:
# :rocket: Jellyfin Server 12.4

We are pleased to announce the latest stable release of Jellyfin, version 12.4! This minor release brings several bugfixes to improve your Jellyfin experience. As always, please ensure you take a full backup before upgrading!

Discuss this release further [on our forums](https://forum.jellyfin.org/t-new-jellyfin-server-web-release-12-4).

## Changelog (1)

### 📈 General Changes
* Update to .net 10.0.14 [PR #18535], by @crobibero

hot_issues.title: [Group]  "Database Locked" on LXC containers using ZFS as storage
Subtitles load after a while and can be out of sync when resuming
Multi disc music albums are displayed as separate albums
SQLite core dump on systems without SSE4.1
[Issue]: All Library Scan causes playlists to disappear
Music (Songs) not added / parsed correctly into Albums
Actors with the same name appear as one person
Jellyfin taking a long time to start live TV playback.

discussions.title: Plugin-Extensible, Timestamp-Aware Search Results in Jellyfin
Personal Project idea: Jellyfin AI Powered – Local AI-assisted metadata and NFO generation
All manually created metadata were lost after upgrading to Jellyfin 12 and rescan libraries.
Multi-instance Live TV: API and client proposal
[Feature] Allow per-user to specify color profile for ffdshow
Download media items with subtitles/metadata/images included as ZIP

detail.readme_excerpt:
Jellyfin

The Free Software Media System

---




--- Jellyfin is a Free Software Media System that puts you in control of managing and streaming your media. It is an alternative to the proprietary Emby and Plex, to provide media from a dedicated server to end-user devices via multiple apps. Jellyfin is descended from Emby's 3.5.2 release and ported to the .NET platform to enable full cross-platform support. There are no strings attached, no premium licenses or features, and no hidden agendas: just a team that wants to build something better and work together to achieve it. We welcome anyone who is interested in joining us in our quest! For further details, please see [our documentation page](https://jellyfin.org/docs/). To receive the latest updates, get help with Jellyfin, and join the community, please visit [one of our communication channels](https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/getting-help). For more information about the project, please see our [about page](https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/about). Want to get started?
Check out our downloads page or our installation guide, then see our quick start guid
